reasons.claim: 3.6 ha regeneration felling notified 2026-10-02; completed-felling overlap 0%, so not ALREADY_FELLED.

Three eligible threatened (VU) site-bound fungi are recorded within 250 m: Boletopsis grisea (141 m, 2025), Albatrellus subrubescens (237 m, latest 2025), Ramaria boreimaxima (242 m, 2025). Each has lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees and soil disturbance from forestry listed as threats, and 10 m coordinate uncertainty.

Five site-bound forest NT fungi are also recorded within 250 m (Ramaria eosanguinea, Lyophyllum semitale, Sarcodon squamosus, Ramaria primulina, Lactarius musteus), mostly 2025 records at 115-205 m. This is supporting evidence.

Recording effort is high (665 records, 98th percentile, 171 observation days). Within 250 m there are 20 records on 6 days. This is a well-surveyed neighbourhood, so the records are less likely to reflect survey bias alone.

uncertainties: The nearest eligible record is 141 m from the edge. No eligible record is inside the polygon (0 records inside), so occupancy of the stand is not shown.
4 coarse records within 250 m were dropped for uncertainty, so some information is excluded.
Records are from 6 observation days within 250 m, and the Albatrellus subrubescens record cited is from 2021.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the notified polygon.
Whether felling would affect these species or what the causes would be.
Anything about sensitive species hidden from public data.
next_action: Prioritise for human ecological review before felling can begin. A reviewer should map the exact positions of the 2025 records against the polygon edge and assess whether the habitat continues into the stand, preferably with a field survey.
